newsitem.title: ITALY: Gemina firms sharply in active Milan trade.
newsitem.headline: Gemina firms sharply in active Milan trade.

text.p: Italian financial holding group Gemina rose strongly in active trading on the Milan stock market.
Dealers said there were unconfirmed rumours about operations concerning the group's subsidiaries and possible acquisitions, adding that Gemina shares were also viewed as undervalued.
"Whatever the rumours are, the shares are at an attractive buying level," one said.
At 1220 GMT, Gemina was 4.25 percent up at 803 lire in volume of over 17 million shares. The all-share Mibtel index was up 0.48 percent.
Gemina announced last month plans to hive off its industrial holdings into a new company, HPI, which would eventually be listed on the Bourse.
